scripts.build: pnpm config:sync && pnpm wasm:build && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.perf:run:dev: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts
scripts.perf:record: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --no-geometry --sample-interval 4 --record
scripts.perf:baseline: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --no-geometry --sample-interval 4 --out tests/perf/bench-baseline.json
scripts.perf:gate: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --no-geometry --sample-interval 4 --baseline tests/perf/bench-baseline.json --threshold 0.1
scripts.perf:gate:climate: pnpm run bench:run:climate-series -- --runs 5 && pnpm run bench:check:climate-runtime -- --baseline tests/perf/climate-bench-baseline.json --threshold 0.15 && pnpm run bench:check:climate-quality -- --baseline tests/perf/climate-bench-baseline.json --window 5 --threshold-runtime 0.15 --max-temp-drop 0.01 --max-precip-drop 0.005 --max-aridity-drop 0.005
scripts.perf:gate:hydrology: pnpm run bench:run:hydrology-series -- --runs 5 && pnpm run bench:check:hydrology-runtime -- --baseline tests/perf/hydrology-bench-baseline.json --threshold 0.15 && pnpm run bench:check:hydrology-quality -- --baseline tests/perf/hydrology-bench-baseline.json --window 5 --threshold-runtime 0.15 --max-flow-rho-drop 0.05 --max-lake-f1-drop 0.05
scripts.perf:baseline:domesticates: pnpm bench --suite domesticates_solo && pnpm run bench:compare:domesticates -- --write-baseline tests/perf/domesticates-bench-baseline.json
scripts.perf:gate:domesticates: pnpm bench --suite domesticates_solo && pnpm run bench:check:domesticates-quality -- --baseline tests/perf/domesticates-bench-baseline.json --threshold-runtime 0.20 --max-metric-drop 0.03 --max-regional-coverage-drop 0.05
scripts.seed:gate:quick: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/seed-regression/scripts/seed-regression.ts --seeds alpha,beta,gamma,delta --ticks 16 --baseline tests/seed-regression/seed-regression-quick-baseline.json --check --threshold 0.005 --threshold-top10-river-flux-sum 0.01
scripts.seed:gate:heavy: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/seed-regression/scripts/seed-regression.ts --seeds alpha,beta,gamma,delta,eta,theta,kappa,mu --ticks 24 --baseline tests/seed-regression/seed-regression-heavy-baseline.json --check --threshold 0.005 --threshold-top10-river-flux-sum 0.01
scripts.outer:validation: pnpm run perf:gate:climate && pnpm run perf:gate:hydrology
scripts.outer:gate: pnpm run outer:contract && pnpm run outer:regression
scripts.outer:gate:full: pnpm run outer:gate && pnpm run outer:benchmark
scripts.bench:resample:ecology-ref: python3 benches/scripts/resample.py --module ecology-ref --centroids benches/data/cell_centroids.csv --output benches/data/ecology_ref.bin --tree-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_tree_cover.tif --non-tree-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_tree_cover.tif --bare-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_vegetated.tif --landcover benches/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_type1.tif --landuse benches/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_prop2.tif --temperature benches/raw/climate/worldclim_tavg_annual_c.tif --precipitation benches/raw/climate/worldclim_prec_annual_mm.tif --river-flow benches/raw/hydrology/glofas_era5_annual_mean.nc --height benches/raw/geology/ETOPO_2022_v1_60s_N90W180_surface.tif --method bilinear
scripts.bench:resample:ecology-ref:with-soil: python3 benches/scripts/resample.py --module ecology-ref --centroids benches/data/cell_centroids.csv --output benches/data/ecology_ref.bin --tree-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_tree_cover.tif --non-tree-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_tree_cover.tif --bare-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_vegetated.tif --landcover benches/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_type1.tif --landuse benches/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_prop2.tif --temperature benches/raw/climate/worldclim_tavg_annual_c.tif --precipitation benches/raw/climate/worldclim_prec_annual_mm.tif --river-flow benches/raw/hydrology/glofas_era5_annual_mean.nc --height benches/raw/geology/ETOPO_2022_v1_60s_N90W180_surface.tif --soil-dir benches/raw/ecology/soilgrids --soil-suffix 0p1deg --soil-w-0-5 5 --soil-w-5-15 3.5 --soil-w-15-30 1.5 --method bilinear
scripts.bench:resample:domesticates-ref: python3 benches/scripts/resample.py --module domesticates-ref --centroids benches/data/cell_centroids.csv --output benches/data/domesticates_ref.bin --manifest benches/raw/domesticates/manifest.json --method bilinear
